about_the_game:
Store Life Simulator (Demo) – Experience the management of a market!

Store Life Simulator (Demo) gives you a limited experience of this simulation and management game! Start with a small grocery store and discover the challenges of running your own business. Hire employees, manage your stock, and serve customers while learning the essential mechanics to grow in the business world.

🛒 Manage Your Store

✅ Control customer flow and keep your shelves stocked.
✅ Set product prices and maximize your profits.
✅ Expand your store (limited in the demo version).

🏠 Go Home and Rest

✅ Close the store and return home at the end of the day.
✅ Time advances when you sleep, allowing for strategic planning.
✅ Face challenges and discover new opportunities every morning.

👥 Hire and Manage Employees

✅ Add cashiers to speed up customer service.
✅ Hire stockers to keep the shelves full.
✅ Have janitors to ensure your store stays clean.
(Limited features in the demo version.)

🏬 Expand Your Business (limited in the demo)

✅ Customize your store and improve management.
✅ Experience part of the business expansion system.

🎨 Low-Poly Graphics

✅ A stylish and charming visual style that adds simplicity and charm.
✅ Lively and dynamic environments with NPCs interacting realistically.

⚠ This is a demo version with limited content.
Enjoying the experience? Get ready to manage an even bigger store in the full version of Store Life Simulator! 🚀
